Finitude of tests is acknowledged; the symbolic proof supplies unbounded quantifiers.

value.rationale: The exact minimum completes a previously published only-upper-bound result for a canonical infinite graph family. Across every rectangular bipartite graph missing a matching, the sharp threshold lies at exactly three deleted edges, independent of graph size. The complementary poset-dimension criterion supplies a reusable structural characterization, not a routine numerical restatement.
